objective: Run one fresh bounded smoke test of the existing GLM-5.3-Flash worker after the owner reports Z.ai payment is complete. Verification-only: prove whether the stored credential now serves traffic.
allowed_scope: Use the existing glm-53-flash worker and deployed generic OpenAI-compatible adapter unchanged unless a newly proven adapter defect prevents execution.
Run exactly one real completion against the configured Z.ai international endpoint using api_model_id glm-5.3-flash.
Use max_tokens <= 16, one attempt, no retry.
Confirm credential presence without revealing the credential value.
Record sanitized evidence only: HTTP status, returned model field, finish reason, provider-returned usage, runtime, and sanitized error if any.
Record E2 linkage through the public governor interface.
If the smoke succeeds, update current execution truth for GLM from the older 429 balance blocker to PASS/routable based on evidence; qualification remains UNPROVEN.
Do not touch E3 Stage 2, other providers, or unrelated files.
stop_conditions: Exactly one GLM completion call maximum.
No secret/key value in GitHub, logs, queue records, or chat.
If provider still refuses traffic, record the exact sanitized blocker and stop.

execution_attempts.summary: One fresh bounded smoke of the existing glm-53-flash worker was run exactly once through the deployed generic OpenAI-compatible adapter (api_model_id=glm-5.3-flash, max_tokens=16, single attempt, no retry) and the provider still refuses traffic: HTTP 429 'Insufficient balance or no resource package. Please recharge.'. The stored credential is present (presence-only check; value never read, printed or stored) and the endpoint answered (read-only GET /models = 200, 11 models, glm-5.3-flash present), so endpoint/credential/model mapping remain verified, but no completion was served: no returned model field, no finish reason, no provider usage (usage null, never estimated), runtime 0.500s. E2 linkage was recorded through the public governor interface (governor.record_request) as obs-20260925-50e4ab40 with status=error and the provider error code; connection/chain verification returned clean. The smoke did NOT succeed, so GLM execution truth was left unchanged per scope: routable=false, smoke_test=FAILED, qualification UNPROVEN — no PASS is claimed. No secret value appears in the repository, logs, queue records or this report (verified by scan of the committed diff and evidence files). E3 Stage 2 was not touched or enabled, and no other provider or unrelated file was modified.
execution_attempts.reason: blocker_category='external_provider' is deterministic; park until the blocking state changes
